Generates a stair profile using a 3D guide curve

**Panel:** Comma → Util · **Nickname:** `StLay`

## Inputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Curve | `C` | Curve | Item |  | 3D guide curve |
| Rise | `Ri` | Number | Item | `180.00` | Target tread height |
| Run | `Ru` | Number | Item | `250.00` | Tread depth |
| Mid Landing | `ML` | Number | Item | `0.00` | Middle landing at 0.5t |
| Angled Riser° | `A°` | Number | Item | `0` | Riser angle from vertical in degrees |

## Outputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Curve | `C` | Curve | Item | Stair curve profile |
| Risers | `Ri` | Line | List | Riser lines |
| Treads | `T` | Line | List | Tread top lines |
| Count | `N` | Integer | List | Number of steps |
| IsComfort | `IC` | Boolean | Item | True if 2h + b = 600 to 640 mm |

## Right-click menu

Options in the component's context menu:

- Target Rise (Run fixed)
- Target Run  (Rise fixed)
- Auto Run (compute Run from 2h+b)
- Auto Rise (compute Rise from 2h+b)
